title: Pharmacokinetics
text: What the body does to a drug, summarised as ADME: absorption, distribution, metabolism and excretion.

children.title: Routes
children.text: Oral, IV, inhaled and transdermal routes differ in speed and completeness.

children.title: Bioavailability
children.text: The fraction of a dose reaching the circulation; IV is 100%.

children.title: Volume of distribution
children.text: A theoretical volume linking dose to plasma concentration. Large values suggest tissue binding.

children.title: Protein binding
children.text: Only unbound drug is active; displacement can cause toxicity.

children.title: Metabolism
children.text: Liver enzymes (CYP450) convert drugs into forms that are easier to excrete.

children.title: Half-life
children.text: Time for the concentration to halve; steady state is reached after about 4–5 half-lives.
